prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 16:10 desktop Electron admin application comp for “Territory Map” in Brazilian Portuguese. This is compositional option 2 within an already chosen contemporary-admin visual language inspired only by the information architecture of “Territórios da Congregação”; do not copy its old Android styling.

Structure first: a compact dark-blue left sidebar with exactly Mapa, Territórios, Publicadores, Histórico completo, congregation identity at top, and “Sair da congregação” isolated at bottom. The main page is a calm consultation hub. At the top, show three equal destination modules: “Publicadores” with subtitle “Territórios retirados e devolvidos”, “Territórios” with subtitle “Publicadores e quadras”, and “Histórico completo” with subtitle “Designações por período”. Below, the selected “Territórios” module opens a split workspace: a searchable numbered territory list on the left two-thirds and a precise map preview plus current assignment summary on the right third. Include a clear view switch “Lista / Mapa” that preserves selection. Use realistic synthetic entries such as “Centro — N5”, “Vila Nova — N12”, publisher names, withdrawal and return dates in dd/mm/yyyy, block counts, and last-work date. Do not invent ministry activity types, study counts, reports, planning, resources, observations, or features absent from PRODUCT.md.

Visual system: exceptionally polished contemporary admin, white and pale blue-gray surfaces, navy text, accessible medium blue primary, restrained green/orange/red semantic status, crisp 1px dividers, modest 6–10px radii, compact humanist sans typography with tabular date numerals. No gradients, glassmorphism, huge KPI cards, floating decoration, photographs, or excessive rounded cards. Production-ready, keyboard-accessible, dense but calm. Render as one straight-on application screenshot with no device frame, watermark, or caption outside the UI.
